table inet mqlsweep { # handle 1
	set blocked { # handle 4
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { 10.0.0.0/8, 172.16.0.0/16,
			     172.20.0.0/16, 192.0.2.1,
			     198.51.100.10-198.51.100.20, 203.0.113.0/28,
			     203.0.113.64/28, 203.0.113.128/28,
			     203.0.113.192/28 }
	}

	set ports { # handle 5
		type inet_service
		elements = { 22, 80, 443 }
	}

	set pairs { # handle 6
		type ipv4_addr . inet_service
		elements = { 192.0.2.10 . 22 }
	}

	set dyn { # handle 7
		type ipv4_addr
		timeout 1h30m
		elements = { 192.0.2.99 timeout 10m expires 9m59s997ms }
	}

	map portmap { # handle 8
		type inet_service : verdict
		elements = { 22 : accept, 8080 : jump probe, 9001 : drop }
	}

	chain probe { # handle 1
		tcp dport 9999 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "mqlsweep" # handle 9
	}

	chain input { # handle 2
		type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop;
		iif "lo" accept # handle 10
		tcp dport @ports accept # handle 11
		jump probe # handle 12
	}

	chain pre { # handle 3
		type nat hook prerouting priority -100; policy accept;
	}
}
table ip dormantt { # handle 2
	flags dormant

	chain c { # handle 1
		type filter hook output priority 10; policy accept;
	}
}
table ip filter { # handle 3
	chain INPUT { # handle 1
		type filter hook input priority 0; policy accept;
		meta l4proto 6 tcp dport 25 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 4
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump MQL # handle 6
	}

	chain FORWARD { # handle 2
		type filter hook forward priority 0; policy accept;
	}

	chain OUTPUT { # handle 3
		type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept;
	}

	chain MQL { # handle 5
	}
}
